products.name: Refuge Recovery (Buddhist) Checklist Template
products.description:
Recovery days go better with structure. This one-page daily checklist gives your Buddhist-path practice a shape you can actually keep: a morning intention, a study cue so the reading happens before the day gets loud, a meditation log with real minutes counted, and an evening review that ends the day honestly.

Print it, work it, repeat it — or keep it on your phone and check items off as you go. The language respects the path: no fluffy affirmations, no toxic positivity — just the daily forms that make practice stick.

Instant PDF download. Print as many copies as you need, for yourself or your sangha.

products.name: SMART Recovery (CBT) Checklist Template
products.description:
The SMART approach is built on tools, not slogans — so this daily checklist runs on the tools too. Each page walks the CBT arc in plain order: spot the activating event, name the belief behind it, check the consequence, then dispute and replace before the evening review.

There's an urge-surfacing prompt for the hard days, a cost-benefit line for when motivation dips, and a tomorrow-plan box so momentum survives the night.

One page. Five minutes. Print a stack for the fridge, the bag, or your meeting group.

Instant PDF download — unlimited personal copies.

products.name: AA / 12-Step Recovery Checklist Template
products.description:
The daily review is where the program becomes a life. This printable checklist gives your day the classic shape: morning quiet time, a resentment scan caught early, one amends or kind action, a contact touch with your sponsor or home group, and an evening review that closes the day clean.

No app, no login — a page you fill out by hand with a coffee before the day starts, or at night before bed. Groups use it as a take-home handout; sponsors keep a stack for sponsees.

Instant PDF download — print as many as you need, forever.

products.name: HVAC Technician Social Media Templates
products.description:
30 days of HVAC content that doesn't sound like an ad. Each day gives you a hook, a caption, and a posting idea — drop in your company name and go. Built for the tech who'd rather be on a roof than writing captions.

Instant ZIP download — one month of posts, ready to schedule.

products.name: Roofing Contractor Spreadsheet Template
products.description:

Instant XLSX download — works in Excel and Google Sheets.

products.name: Appliance Repair Checklist Template
products.description:

A built-in warranty slip means a callback becomes a documented service call — not an argument about what was and wasn't covered. The homeowner signs the finish line.

Instant PDF download — print a stack for the van.

products.name: Air Duct Cleaning Social Media Templates

A summary tab turns the technicals into a quote a property manager can approve without calling you twice — and the paper trail is the kind that wins disputes.

Instant XLSX download — Excel and Google Sheets compatible.

products.name: Home Energy Auditor Spreadsheet Template

The summary tab makes the report feel like a plan instead of a lecture, and the structured numbers keep your recommendations defensible when someone pushes back.

Instant XLSX download — Excel and Google Sheets compatible.
